description: 明亮、干净、柔和的日系人像与日常记录方向，重点是去脏、保肤色和通透感。
avoid_scenes: 需要浓重情绪的暗调照片

visual_features.color: clean skin, controlled greens, gentle warm highlights
visual_features.texture: soft clarity and low dirty color cast

tone_guidance.texture: soft clarity and low dirty color cast

color_guidance.overall: clean skin, controlled greens, gentle warm highlights
color_guidance.subject_protection: Preserve believable subject color and avoid destructive casts.

adjustment_plan_guidance.rule: Treat this knowledge as a reusable visual direction. Inspect the target photo before generating concrete values.
adjustment_plan_guidance.variant_policy: Generate one best variant by default; add alternates only when several directions genuinely fit.

agent_guidance: 先处理画面发黄、发灰、发脏的问题，再决定整体亮度。
肤色和白色物体优先保持可信，绿色只做清理不做过度风格化。
